gate_trace_upper_bound_summary.warning: This trace is not the accepted run and includes prompt/decode costs; crediting it as decode saving is optimistic.

hard_bound_conclusion.reason: A whole native DS4 MoE layer costs about 3264 MiB VRAM. Current accepted path has only 238 MiB free and 13566 MiB gate cache, so at most four full layers can fit even by repurposing the entire gate cache. The best arbitrary four-layer zero-overhead up/down saving is below the 17254.867 ms required decode saving. Even the extreme ceiling that credits the entire rejected gate trace to those layers remains below 10 tok/s; any real implementation also pays GPU compute/allocator/sync cost and gate-cache loss.

inputs.note: Gate trace is from rejected touch-split diagnostic and is used only as an optimistic extra saving upper bound.

model_vram_facts.actual_cli_semantics: --n-cpu-moe N keeps first N MoE layers on CPU; reducing N offloads tail layers 39,38,... first for this 40-MoE-layer CPU range.

purpose: Hard-bound full MoE layer GPU placement/front-CPU-back-GPU route after async I/O was closed.
